mapper.select: select id, tenant_id, unit_code, unit_name, area_id, unit_type, sort_no, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted from base_unit where id = #{id} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and deleted = 0

select id, tenant_id, unit_code, unit_name, area_id, unit_type, sort_no, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted from base_unit where id = #{id} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and status = 'ENABLED' and deleted = 0
select id, tenant_id, unit_code, unit_name, area_id, unit_type, sort_no, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted from base_unit where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and unit_code = #{code} and deleted = 0
mapper.update: update base_unit set unit_name = #{unitName}, area_id = #{areaId}, unit_type = #{unitType}, sort_no = #{sortNo}, status = #{status}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and deleted = 0
update base_unit set status = #{status}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and deleted = 0
update base_unit set deleted = 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and deleted = 0
